critical_steps: For right composition Lambda_j O, synthesis is O^*T_Lambda.
For a dual pair, transformed mixed operator is O_2^*O_1.
The transformed coordinate family loses the first coordinate and is not a frame.
O_2^*O_1 determines the exact and strict-norm approximate criteria.
integrity.proof_basis: Exact synthesis identity and unilateral shift in ell^2(N).
integrity.unproved_limits: This does not assess unrelated theorems or rule out an unindexed correction.

scientific_limitations: Only Theorem 3.1 is corrected; other characterization and perturbation theorems are not reassessed.
The exact-branch counterexample is infinite-dimensional; in finite dimension the source one-sided inverse implies the corrected identity.
Two highly relevant comparison full texts were inaccessible; a prior unindexed correction remains possible.
title: Adjoints reverse the operator transport condition for dual \(g\)-frames
